initialGeneration.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final full-bleed 16:9 opaque background for a cozy mobile pixel-art sheep game.
Primary request: redraw this scene in the SAME coarse blocky pixel-art visual language as the farm main menu in reference Image 1.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the sole STYLE reference: use its cheerful blocky rural game illustration, square stair-step edges, grouped rounded foliage, bold readable contours, restrained simple two or three tone shading. Image 2 is only a LAYOUT / PLACE reference; DO NOT inherit its dense microtexture, tiny foliage or photorealistic rendering.
Style and detail: every visible contour is a clear square-pixel staircase, confident big pixel clusters, simple broad grouped foliage, no leaf speckles, no antialiasing or smooth painted gradients. Night scenes stay clear and pleasantly readable; use blue teal lavender meadow colors with warm amber lamps, no black overlay. Lower visual complexity than Image 2 and consistent with Image 1.
Output: exactly ONE cohesive landscape scene, one full image, horizontal 16:9, edge-to-edge opaque pixels. No atlas, grid, collage, frames, UI, written words, labels, logos or watermark.
Scene: a coastal meadow at lavender twilight with a light peach sunset above a quiet sea on the RIGHT, distant pale blue coast. A large round pixel-cluster tree on the LEFT and a tiny cream farm cottage with orange roof and a warm square window, short simple wooden fence and very large rounded bushes. Rolling cool teal meadow, just a few big flowers at the margins. Preserve the sunset-coast identity of Image 2 but give it the friendly farm simplicity of Image 1. Sky is open lavender/peach flat color bands and two or three big stepped cloud shapes. No detailed town, stone cliffs, water glitter or tiny clouds. Gameplay composition invariant: distant horizon about 60% image height. A grass rim crosses FULL width at exactly 72% image height. An empty warm tan dirt road fills the FULL width from 72% to 96% image height; use a small bottom grass strip only below 96%. Road must be wide uninterrupted horizontal band, level, simple and quiet. Nothing on the road: no actor, object, fence, rock, flowers, mailbox, grass clumps, or branches in the road. Keep all scene objects ABOVE road, in background. Flat side-scrolling view with no perspective road into depth.
No characters anywhere. Limited broad colors, substantial quiet negative sky and road.

validation.roadPlacement: top approximately 72 percent, bottom approximately 94 percent; full width and unobstructed; final nearest packing/alignment belongs to root
